View.description: The root: its children are painted in order, each into a slot reserved when the root arrives

Text.description: A paragraph; **bold** is the only emphasis

Legend.description: Legend chips, each "mark label"; the sample is drawn with the figure's own class

Table.description: A small table: header cells, then rows of cells

Callout.description: A section with a rule and a short tag ("Where it breaks"), never a box

Steps.description: A stepper: one figure, the steps, an optional frontier row and status table; Back/Next below

Predict.description: Pick an answer; the pick is posted with the answer ref to the server, the page never resolves or draws it

Reveal.description: A visible locked row; its body arrives as a second program when the stage changes

Answer.description: The boxed answer and one sentence

Doodle.description: A small drawing when nothing else fits (visual first)

Graph.description: A graph: nodes "A 48 100, B 160 48", edges "A>B, A-C" (> directed), column labels "48 depth 0", marks "A:done u0:k1"

Geometry.description: A to-scale geometry figure: named points "A 0,0; B 3,0; C 3,4" (y up), marks seg(A,B) circle(O,2) right(B,A,C) dim(A,B,3 m) angle(A,B,C,$\theta$) arrow(A,C,$F$) label(C,top); at most 12 points, 12 marks, 6 labels; a number in a label is a given, never the answer

Link.description: A connector between two points or anchors; a vector's to may be relative "+0,-1.5"; q = a Q id

Axes.description: A plot frame: x / y "min,max label", items "f curve x^2/2+1", "R riemann f 0 4 n left", "m marker y 60 your guess"

MathRows.description: Math, one step per row, aligned on the first =; {qid} tokens

Code.description: Source lines; the highlight follows a Trace or set hl

Trace.description: The engine runs a Code and shows vars per tick; never write ticks (the server fills them)

Cells.description: An array, stack or grid of cells; ptrs "i:0 j:4"

Bars.description: Bars "label: expr"; conserve = they share the total, so a drain shows

Q.description: A quantity: given (value), derived (expr), answer (expr, shown only after a solve), unknown (symbol)

Ask.description: A question with 2-4 choices on a scene step; the next step shows the answer to it
